title: Intermede Champetre
identity: Philippe Gaubert’s Intermède champêtre was originally for oboe and piano; Marcel Mule transcribed it for alto saxophone and piano in Leduc AL21161. Library and retailer records confirm the saxophone transcription, including score and part. This is a historically distinct arrangement, not an original saxophone composition.

evidence.claim: Identifies original oboe-and-piano work and Marcel Mule transcription for alto saxophone and piano, Leduc 1946, score and part.
Confirms AL21161, 1946 publication and transcription credit to Marcel Mule; page count 8+4.

review_focus: Compare the saxophone arrangement with the oboe source; inspect whether the saxophone part preserves the source line and how its breathing and phrasing are handled. These remain score-review questions.
collection_flag: Documented transcription of an oboe-and-piano work by Marcel Mule.

listening.verification: Recording/product metadata checked; playback not auditioned

gaps: No score notation or saxophone recording inspected.
